mcq_drop.why: oddly worded comparative item (jagir vs iqta/Nayankara/ICS); not exam style

patterns: Mostly direct single facts: introduced by Akbar, borrowed from Mongol/Central Asian model, run by Mir Bakhshi, do-aspa sih-aspa = Jahangir
Statement sets probe traps: hereditary? (no), sawar could exceed zat? (no), civil officers also mansabdars? (yes), three classes (yes)
Ahadis (singly enlisted, emperor as colonel) and the 10 sawar = 20 horses rule recur in A/R form
Administrative units (chakla, pargana-sarkar-subah order) appear alongside mansab items
App goes deeper (historiography of jagirdari crisis, shashmaha/sihmaha, jagir types) than PYQs, which stay at definitional level
